opening = \"\"\"Subh rahe aur shaam rahe

\"\"\"
closing = refrain + title_refrain + chant
repeated_opening = opening + \"Maula tera uncha sada naam rahe\\n\" + chant
preamble = chant + opening * 2 + title_refrain * 2 + refrain + chant
stanzas = [
\"\"\"Mulkoṅ mulkoṅ mein tera maatam ya Husain
Shehroṅ shehroṅ mein tera maatam ya Husain
Gaaoṅ gaaoṅ mein tera maatam ya Husain
Halkaaye aashiqaаṅ Husain ya Husaina
Maatam kare jawaaṅ Husain ya Husaina
\"\"\".replace(\"а\", \"a\") + closing,

\"\"\" + closing,
\"\"\"Laakhoṅ karoroṅ azaadaar tere
Aaye haiṅ shauq-e-ziyaarat le ke

Zawwaar main banuṅ Husain ya Husaina
Paidal safar karuṅ Husain ya Husaina
Tujh se aakar miluṅ Husain ya Husaina
Tera nauha parhuṅ Husain ya Husaina
Aisa maatam karuṅ Husain ya Husaina
Ye jism aur ye khuṅ Husain ya Husaina
Tujh pe main waar duṅ Husain ya Husaina
Tere liye jiyuṅ Husain ya Husaina
Tere liye maruṅ Husain ya Husaina
\"\"\" + repeated_opening,
\"\"\"Teri behen ki dua hai ya Husain
Ghar ghar mein farsh-e-aza hai ya Husain
Ye Sayyida ki ata hai ya Husain
Hai mir-e-kaarwaaṅ Husain ya Husaina
Tu aur teri maaṅ Husain ya Husaina
\"\"\" + closing,
\"\"\"Ham haiṅ tere tu hamaara ya Husain
Gunje ka ab yahi naara ya Husain

\"\"\" + closing,
\"\"\"Ya Husain
Aaqa Husain
Rehnuma Husain
Daastaaṅ Husain
Hausla Husain
Maujiza Husain
Ku ba ku,

Aarzu,
Justuju,
Guftugu Husain
Aayateṅ,
Neamateṅ,
Rehmateṅ Husain
Aasmaaṅ,
Saaibaaṅ,
Kahkashaaṅ Husain
Haiṅ zamaaṅ Husain
Haiṅ makaaṅ Husain
Haiṅ nihaaṅ Husain
Haiṅ ayaaṅ Husain
Bahr o bar,
Chaaragar,
Sher-e-nar Husain
Hai idhar,
Hai idhar,
Arsh par Husain
La ila Husain
Karbala Husain
Ibtida Husain
Intiha Husain
\"\"\" + repeated_opening,
\"\"\"Mujh ko wo din bhi dikhaana ya Husain
Khul ke ho rona rulaana ya Husain
Aake Imaam-e-Zamaana ya Husain
Maatam kareṅ yahaaṅ Husain ya Husaina
Sab ho mahw-e-faghaaṅ Husain ya Husaina
\"\"\" + closing,
\"\"\"Jis din se hosh sambhaala ya Husain
Ghar mein alam tera dekha ya Husain
Phir nauha parhna sikha ya Husain
Jab se wird-e-zabaaṅ Husain ya Husaina
Main tera nauha khwaaṅ Husain ya Husaina
\"\"\" + closing,
\"\"\"Saanseṅ rawaaṅ haiṅ Maula tere liye
Ye dil o jaaṅ hai Maula tere liye
Pairau jawaaṅ haiṅ Maula tere liye
Ye kaarwaaṅ hai Maula tere liye
Kaun o makaaṅ hai Maula tere liye
Saare jahaaṅ hai Maula tere liye
\"\"\" + opening + chant,
\"\"\"Apne ghamoṅ ko bhula kar ya Husain
Rote haiṅ teri aza par ya Husain
Ye tere Farhaan o Mazhar ya Husain
Ye jism aur ye jaaṅ Husain ya Husaina
Tere liye haiṅ haaṅ Husain ya Husaina
\"\"\" + closing + \"Aaqa Husain\\n\",
]
roman = \"\\n\\n\".join([preamble.rstrip()] + [
    f\"{number}\\n{stanza.rstrip()}\" for number, stanza in enumerate(stanzas, 1)
])
source_verses = [line for line in body.decode().splitlines() if line.strip()]
roman_verses = [line for line in roman.splitlines() if line and not line.isascii() or line and not line.isdigit()]
assert len(source_verses) == len(roman_verses), (len(source_verses), len(roman_verses))
for source, rendering in zip(source_verses, roman_verses):
    assert source.count(\"حسین\") == rendering.count(\"Husain\"), (source, rendering)
    assert source.endswith(\"،\") == rendering.endswith(\",\"), (source, rendering)
assert all(char.isascii() or char in \"ṅṄ\" for char in roman)
scalar = \"\\n\".join(\"  \" + line if line else \"\" for line in roman.splitlines()).encode()
updated = header.replace(b'tags: [\"noRoman\"]', b'tags: []') + b\"\\nromanLyrics: |-\\n\" + scalar + b\"\\n---\\n\" + body
p.write_bytes(updated)
assert p.read_bytes().split(b\"\\n---\\n\", 1)[1] == body
print(f\"Verified {len(source_verses)} aligned verse lines across the opening and {len(stanzas)} numbered stanzas. Urdu body is byte-identical.\")
